# Freshness regression to preserve
Equal-byte-length edits plus os.utime restoring st_mtime_ns can evade a size/mtime shortcut. Read full source content and compare the content hash on each query to preserve rejection of any changed content. A regression test must alter content while restoring both stat fields and still reject the old cache. Reduce duplicate reads/parsing without introducing TTL, watchers or stat-only acceptance.
